mechanism_narrative: The historically low federal funds rate (0.37%) compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in prolonged monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Co-occurrence of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL 3-month change > 0.5%) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates 'sticky inflation' that forces equity risk premiums higher, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with CPIAUCSL 3mo change > 0.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle labor market slowdown (UNRATE > 5.0% and 3-month UNRATE change > 0.2%) indicates deteriorating economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE > 5.0% AND UNRATE 3mo change > 0.2% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1000 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with HOUST < 1000 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above the 2017 base (INDPRO > 100) indicates robust supply conditions that reduce equity risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods with INDPRO > 100 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Co-occurrence of weak housing starts (HOUST < 1000) and low residential sales (RSAFS < 400000) indicates a broad demand slowdown, increasing equity risk premiums and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with HOUST < 1000 AND RSAFS < 400000 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE > 5.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.
